subject.title: [Bug]: Skill Workshop agent-tool apply times out because approval wait exceeds tool watchdog

question: Should this issue be fixed through the broader approval-flow repair in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100498, the narrower watchdog-only repair in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/91325, or a different owner-approved shape?
rationale: The choice affects the Skill Workshop lifecycle approval boundary, operator timeout semantics, and whether proposal metadata/blocked timeout behavior ships with the watchdog fix.

options.title: Review PR 100498
options.body: Use the broader maintainer-authored repair that bounds the approval wait, improves the approval payload, and keeps timeout behavior fail-closed.

options.title: Land narrow timeout repair
options.body: Use the smaller Codex watchdog extension from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/91325 and leave approval-card details to separate issues.

options.title: Keep designing
options.body: Hold both PRs if maintainers want a different approval contract before changing this security-sensitive flow.

recommendation.title: Review PR 100498
recommendation.body: Use the broader maintainer-authored repair that bounds the approval wait, improves the approval payload, and keeps timeout behavior fail-closed.

likelyOwner.reason: He is assigned to this issue and authored the active broader fix candidate.
